query: For FASTag auto-replenishment, is an alert after debit still required when the pre-debit notice is waived?

references.quote: An issuer shall send a post-transaction notification

expected_answer: The RBI e-mandate directions exempt specified auto-replenishment mandates from pre-transaction notification, while separately requiring the issuer to send a post-transaction notification. Do not extend the pre-transaction exemption to post-transaction notices.
